sloka: ततो राक्षससैन्यं च हरीणां च महद्बलम् ।प्रगृहीतप्रहरणं निश्चेष्टं समतिष्ठत ।। ६.१०९.२ ।।
transliteration: tato rākṣasasainyaṁ ca harīṇāṁ ca mahadbalam ।pragṛhītapraharaṇaṁ niśceṣṭaṁ samatiṣṭhata ।। 6.109.2 ।।

translations.english: Then, both Rakshasa army and huge Vanara army, stood motionless holding their weapons ready.
